name: io.github.md-f-sarker/compositor-mcp-server
description: Deep Model Context Protocol integration for the Compositor macOS image editor — 62 native, undoable editing operations (layers, masks, selections, painting, retouching, filters, exports) behind a small search/execute surface with atomic batches, dry runs, preconditions and a filesystem allowlist.

environmentVariables.name: COMPOSITOR_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Bridge request timeout in milliseconds (raise for long-running operations on large documents)

environmentVariables.name: COMPOSITOR_MCP_MOCK
environmentVariables.description: Set to "1" to run against the deterministic mock bridge without the Compositor app
